description:
Vem ser GUARACAMP !

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco no resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, buscamos gente boa para formar um time forte , com atitude de dono, espírito de realização e sede por evolução. Valorizamos quem acredita que tudo pode ser feito melhor , com transparência, disciplina e vontade de fazer acontecer . Se você se identifica com esses princípios e quer deixar sua marca no mundo , seu lugar é com a gente!

A Guaracamp disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec. 3.298-99.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO:

Atuar estrategicamente na expansão da presença comercial da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento e gestão de distribuidores, com foco em regiões do estado do Rio de Janeiro onde ainda não atuamos. O objetivo principal é consolidar a operação do distribuidor já fechado, estruturando rotas, metas e execução, além de identificar, negociar e implantar novos parceiros comerciais que garantam capilaridade, volume e excelência na distribuição dos nossos produtos. Este cargo tem papel fundamental na consolidação da marca em novos territórios, contribuindo diretamente com o crescimento sustentável e escalável da companhia.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Desenvolver e acompanhar o distribuidor atual, apoiando em estrutura, rotas, metas e execução no ponto de venda.
  • Realizar mapeamento de novas regiões com potencial para expansão via distribuidores.
  • Prospectar, negociar e fechar com novos distribuidores nas regiões-alvo.
  • Conduzir o onboarding de novos distribuidores, garantindo alinhamento com a cultura, metas e políticas comerciais da empresa.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance dos distribuidores (sell-in, sell-out, cobertura de mercado, positivação e execução).
  • Estabelecer rotinas de acompanhamento em campo com as equipes dos distribuidores.
  • Assegurar execução da marca nos pontos de venda, conforme padrões de excelência da companhia.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os times internos (marketing, trade, logística e financeiro) para garantir suporte à operação dos distribuidores.
  • Reportar periodicamente os resultados e avanços da expansão.

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência no setor de bebidas, alimentos ou bens de consumo de giro rápido.
  • Conhecimento do canal indireto e atuação em todo Rio de Janeiro.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e Excel intermediário/avançado.

COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Perfil empreendedor e com atitude de dono.
  • Organização, disciplina e foco em metas.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal e comunicação eficaz.
  • Autonomia e resiliência em ambientes desafiadores e em crescimento.

description:
Topcon Positioning Group is headquartered in Livermore, California, USA (topconpositioning.com).

We design, manufacture and distribute productivity tools for developing a brighter future. Whether cultivating the earth or building upon it, Topcon brings innovation in workflow automation and seamless connectivity of data to construction, geopositioning and agriculture industries focused on developing a sustainable tomorrow.

To learn more about Topcon career opportunities go to

Position Overview

The Topcon Dealer Sales Manager for Latin America is responsible for managing and growing the dealer network for surveying instruments and related geomatics/construction solutions across the LATAM region. This role focuses on strategic channel development, sales execution, market expansion, and ensuring dealer excellence in representing the company’s full product portfolio. The position requires strong cultural awareness, deep understanding of surveying/construction workflows in a Latin America context, and proven channel sales experience.

Key Responsibilities

Dealer Management & Development

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop high‑performing dealers across Latin America.
  • Establish yearly dealer business plans, including revenue targets, marketing actions, and product focus.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, assessing KPIs and identifying improvement areas.
  • Ensure dealer compliance with brand standards, pricing policy, and channel programs.
  • Grow competences around Topcon’s business systems and tools.

Sales Execution & Growth

  • Achieve regional sales targets for surveying instruments and geomatics/construction solutions.
  • Identify new market opportunities and plan territory expansion initiatives.
  • Support dealers with pipeline development, major opportunities, and competitive positioning.
  • Lead product launches, promotional campaigns, and regional sales events.

Training & Enablement

  • Deliver product and sales training to dealer teams (in Spanish).
  • Coordinate with product management and marketing for updated materials and competitive insights.
  • Support field demonstrations, trade shows, technical events, and customer roadshows.

Market Intelligence

  • Monitor regional market trends, competitive activities, and customer demands.
  • Provide structured feedback to leadership regarding market needs and product requirements.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of geomatics, GNSS, optical instruments, and construction layout workflows.

Operational & Administrative

  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, CRM updates, and dealer documentation.
  • Manage travel, budgets, and dealer program expenditures responsibly.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with marketing, customer service, logistics, and technical support.
  • Ensure familiarity with Biz Hub and other Topcon business tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Geomatics, Surveying, or related field.
  • Fluent Spanish (required) ; strong English communication skills.
  • 5+ years of experience in channel/dealer sales, ideally in geomatics, surveying, construction, or related technical equipment sectors.
  • Strong understanding of GNSS, robotic total stations, levels, lasers, and field software.
  • Proven record of achieving sales targets in multi‑country territories.
  • Ability to travel 40–60% across Latin America.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Portuguese language skills.
  • Previous experience with LATAM distribution networks in surveying or construction technology.
  • Knowledge of civil engineering, mapping, land development, or construction workflows.
  • Residence near a major U.S. international airport.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic channel development
  • Relationship building & cultural adaptability
  • Technical aptitude with geomatics instruments
  • Negotiation & closing skills
  • Presentation and training capability
  • CRM and pipeline management
  • Strong self‑motivation and independence

title: Quality Commercial Enablement Jr Manager
description:
About The Company

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada. Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

About The Team/role

You will join, as an individual contributor, the newly established Commercial Quality team within our Commercial Enablement structure at 99Food, an operation committed to scaling high-performance field sales with the right skills, consistency, and impact. Your mission is to act as the "quality gatekeeper", monitoring everything that may go wrong in the sales operation, from skill execution to system usage and process adherence, and ensuring rapid diagnosis and correction. This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Conduct audits across the commercial journey, observing field visits, CRM/system logs, demos, emails, and adherence to playbooks, to identify deviations and opportunities.
  • Manage with the team, frequent field visits alongside Business Developers to observe live execution, assess coaching needs, and validate actual vs. documented behavior.
  • Analyze usage patterns in CRMs and other commercial tools to detect gaps, underutilization, or misuse, feeding insights back into training, KB, and process improvement.
  • Act as a guardian of excellence: monitor compliance with playbooks, process flow, KB, and use of tools, and ensure alignment for every BD interaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Operations, and Tech teams to translate QA findings into enhancements, improving Knowledge Base, training modules, workflows, and system improvements.
  • Produce recurring reports on QA insights, emerging gaps, trends, and prioritized recommendations for rapid corrective action and strategic evolution.
  • Coach and mentor QA Specialists, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, consistency, and data-based quality execution.
  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in quality management, process auditing, Sales QA, especially in field sales, tech, or scaling environments.
  • Proven ability to design robust QA frameworks, including scorecards, performance grids, audit routines, and escalation pathways.
  • High analytical capacity: you convert both quantitative data (CRM, metrics, dashboards) and qualitative observations (field, demos) into actionable insights.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, site/system usage tracking, and understanding of how systems impact commercial behavior.
  • Hands-on mindset and physical presence: comfortable conducting field visits, in-person assessments, and working closely with on-the-ground teams.
  • Strong communication skills, with assertiveness to raise operational gaps and collaborate across functions to solve them.
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, with proven results in bringing quality insights into actionable interventions (training, KB updates, process/system refinements).
  • Certifications like Six Sigma / Black Belt or Enablement experience are a plus.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

description:
Overview

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Guest Operations Stadium Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of seamless V/VIP guest services and operations within the stadiums for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, internal FIFA27 teams, and external stakeholders. The role acts as the primary point of reference for all stadium guest operations, ensuring efficient planning, staff readiness, and high-quality service delivery during match operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of V/VIP services and guest operations across assigned stadiums.
  • Establish, manage, and coordinate stadium-level Guest Operations teams, ensuring clear task allocation in line with the event scope.
  • Support the Guest Operations Senior Manager in the development and implementation of Concepts of Operations, policies, and procedures.
  • Communicate guest management policies, stadium operational plans, and updates to all relevant internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure management of V/VIP Guests (local & international) is according to agreed operational plans.
  • Ensure agreed service levels are consistently delivered in collaboration with internal departments, service providers, and partners.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Guest Experience Manager on the planning and delivery of V/VIP catering services and lounge experience within the stadium environment.
  • Develop, monitor, and manage key milestones, activity schedules, and workflows, ensuring clear prioritisation and timely delivery.
  • Contribute to budget planning and support the monitoring and review of stadium guest operations expenditures.
  • Plan and deliver stadium-specific V/VIP operations training for Guest Operations Stadium staff, volunteers, hosts, and hostesses.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Tourism, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • A Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is considered an asset.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Guest Operations, Event Services, Protocol, or Hospitality operations within major events, preferably international sports events.
  • Proven experience in stadium or venue-based operations, including V/VIP services and multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including planning, coordination, and operational delivery.
  • Experience working with multiple service providers and cross-functional teams in complex operational settings.
  • Experience in budget planning, cost monitoring, and financial tracking is desirable.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organisational, planning, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to drive operational excellence and deliver high-quality guest services through structured processes and teamwork.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships at all levels.
  • High level of attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and sound judgement under pressure.
  • Good understanding of organisational processes, governance, and operational policies.
  • Solid financial awareness, including budget management and cost control.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and event days, as required by the tournament schedule.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural and international environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people-led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Position Overview

The Product Specialist acts as the key link between the companys product portfolio, its commercial partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject-matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted.

Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Key Responsibilities

Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Provide data-driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go-to-market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with distributors, partners, and end-user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field-based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high-growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long-term career progression.

Olá, muito prazer, nós somos a inChurch!

A única plataforma no Brasil de desenvolvimento apps, sites, totens nativos para as igrejas.

Somos muito mais que tecnologia e inovação: somos pessoas movidas por desafios e vamos transformar a inChurch na melhor e maior empresa global de Tecnologia e Inovação para Igrejas.

A gente sonha grande e buscamos por pessoas que tenham brilho nos olhos, paixão pelo que faz e queiram compartilhar uma trajetória de crescimento conosco.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Suporte N2 , com perfil técnico, analítico e fortemente orientado à experiência do cliente, para apoiar a operação de atendimento e fazer a ponte entre Suporte, Customer Success e Tecnologia em um ambiente SaaS.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no atendimento de tickets escalados (N2), realizando análise de causa raiz e propondo soluções definitivas.
  • Operar, configurar e evoluir chatbots e agentes de IA para atendimento (intents, fluxos, automações, handoff, curadoria e melhoria contínua).
  • Criar, manter e otimizar automações de atendimento e backoffice integrando Chatbot, HubSpot, Jira e demais sistemas via n8n, webhooks e APIs .
  • Realizar análise e report de tickets no Jira Service Management , estruturando informações técnicas claras para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar em HubSpot para gestão de chamados, histórico de clientes, SLAs, pipelines e jornadas.
  • Trabalhar com plataformas omnichannel (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Movidesk ou similares), garantindo organização, métricas e qualidade do atendimento.
  • Construir e manter base de conhecimento (FAQs, artigos técnicos, runbooks e playbooks).
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores como SLA, TMA, FCR, backlog, reincidência e CSAT .
  • Participar de análises de incidentes críticos (post‑mortem) e definição de planos de prevenção.
  • Atuar como ponte entre Suporte, CS e Tech , traduzindo problemas de negócio em linguagem técnica e vice-versa.
  • Apoiar a estruturação de dashboards e relatórios operacionais para acompanhamento da saúde do suporte.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como Suporte N2 (ou N1 avançado) em empresas SaaS / B2B .
  • Vivência prática com chatbots e agentes de IA para atendimento (configuração, treinamento, automações e melhoria de respostas).
  • Experiência com Jira Service Management (abertura, priorização, categorização, SLAs e comunicação técnica).
  • Conhecimento sólido em CRMs , preferencialmente HubSpot (tickets, workflows, automações e relatórios).
  • Experiência com plataformas de gestão de conversas e tickets (omnichannel).
  • Vivência com automações de processos usando ferramentas como n8n, HubSpot Workflows, APIs REST e webhooks .
  • Capacidade analítica para diagnóstico de problemas, leitura técnica e documentação clara.
  • Comunicação estruturada e orientada a resolução.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com integrações via API e arquitetura de automações end‑to‑end (chatbot → CRM → Jira → BI).
  • Conhecimento em SQL, análise de logs ou ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana, etc.).
  • Vivência com event‑driven automation e orquestração de fluxos no n8n .
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala , múltiplos produtos e alta complexidade operacional.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de Customer Success , Health Score e jornada do cliente.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de Incident Management, ITIL ou SRE (nível conceitual) .

title: Suporte de TI – Nível 2
description:
Cargo: Analista de Suporte de TI

Área: Tecnologia da Informação
Nível: Pleno / Sênior
Experiência mínima: 4 anos em Suporte Técnico, Infraestrutura ou Redes

A NAS IT está em busca de um Analista de Suporte N2 com perfil técnico e analítico, capaz de atuar em ambientes corporativos de missão crítica. O profissional será responsável por diagnosticar, resolver e documentar incidentes de nível intermediário e avançado em redes, servidores, segurança e conectividade, além de apoiar o time N1 e contribuir para a evolução contínua dos ambientes sob gestão. Esperamos um profissional autônomo, proativo e comunicativo, com domínio em Mikrotik, Fortinet, Zabbix, Grafana e soluções UniFi (Ubiquiti), além de boa compreensão de arquiteturas em nuvem e boas práticas de segurança.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no suporte de 2º nível, assumindo chamados escalonados e incidentes de maior complexidade;
  • Diagnosticar e resolver falhas em redes LAN/WAN, servidores e serviços corporativos;
  • Configurar e administrar roteadores Mikrotik, com foco em roteamento dinâmico (OSPF/BGP), Load Balance, Failover, QoS e segurança;
  • Implementar, gerenciar e otimizar firewalls Fortinet (FortiGate), com análise e relatórios via FortiAnalyzer;
  • Gerenciar e manter monitoramento proativo com Zabbix e Grafana, incluindo alertas, KPIs e dashboards de desempenho;
  • Instalar e configurar Access Points UniFi (Ubiquiti), realizando o gerenciamento via UniFi Controller e integração com VLANs e redes segmentadas;
  • Realizar troubleshooting de conectividade, latência, VPNs e balanceamento de carga;
  • Criar e manter políticas de backup, restore e documentação de ambientes;
  • Gerenciar Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPOs e permissões de acesso;
  • Apoiar a equipe N1, fornecendo direcionamento técnico e validando correções aplicadas;
  • Executar tarefas de automação, scripts e integrações que otimizem a operação;
  • Contribuir com a padronização e evolução dos ambientes de TI sob gestão da NAS IT.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo ou cursando em Redes de Computadores, Segurança da Informação, Gestão da Tecnologia da Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em suporte técnico ou infraestrutura corporativa;

Conhecimento avançado em

  • Mikrotik RouterOS – roteamento dinâmico (OSPF/BGP), Load Balance, Failover, QoS, firewall e VPN;
  • Fortinet FortiGate e FortiAnalyzer – políticas, UTM, SD-WAN, VPN, análise de logs e relatórios;
  • Zabbix e Grafana – configuração de templates, triggers, dashboards e alertas automatizados;
  • Ubiquiti UniFi – controladora, provisionamento de APs, VLANs e redes segmentadas;
  • Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, File Server e políticas de grupo (GPOs);
  • Microsoft 365, Azure e ambientes híbridos em nuvem;
  • Windows Server, Linux e virtualização (VMware/Hyper-V).

Diferenciais

  • Certificações: MTCNA / MTCRE, Fortinet NSE 3+, Zabbix Certified Specialist, UniFi Network Specialist;
  • Experiência com PowerShell, automação de tarefas, API e scripts de integração;
  • Vivência em ambientes gerenciados (MSP/NOC/SOC);
  • Conhecimento em políticas de segurança da informação e LGPD;
  • Inglês técnico intermediário.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas;
  • Capacidade de documentar e padronizar procedimentos técnicos;
  • Boa comunicação e postura profissional com clientes corporativos;
  • Foco em melhoria contínua e colaboração com o time.

Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação;
  • Day Off no aniversário;
  • Trabalho home office em escala programada;
  • Vale Transporte ou auxílio deslocamento;
  • Ambiente de inovação, aprendizado contínuo e crescimento profissional.

title: Executive Assistant BRA (Remote)
description:
An Executive Assistant (EA) provides high-level administrative support to executives, senior leaders, or company founders, ensuring their schedules, communications, and daily operations run smoothly . This role acts as a strategic partner, enabling executives to focus on decision-making and leadership responsibilities while the EA manages essential organizational and logistical tasks behind the scenes.

Typical responsibilities include coordinating complex calendars with multiple time zones, organizing and prioritizing meetings, preparing agendas, and ensuring executives are fully briefed ahead of engagements. Executive Assistants also arrange travel itineraries —including flights, accommodations, and transportation—while anticipating potential issues and providing contingency plans.

Beyond scheduling, EAs are often responsible for drafting and editing correspondence , preparing high-quality reports, presentations, and briefing documents , and managing internal and external communications on behalf of the executive. Handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion is critical, as is maintaining a professional demeanor when liaising with board members, clients, and other stakeholders.

An effective EA also monitors project timelines , follows up on action items, and acts as a gatekeeper—managing requests for the executive’s time and attention while balancing competing priorities. They often identify opportunities to streamline processes, implement productivity tools , and enhance the efficiency of the executive office.

Success in this position requires exceptional organizational skills , keen attention to detail, adaptability in fast-paced and high-pressure environments, and excellent communication abilities. The most effective Executive Assistants combine administrative expertise with strategic thinking, becoming an indispensable partner in the achievement of organizational goals.

Daily responsibilities often include planning editorial calendars , creating engaging text, image, and video content, scheduling and publishing posts, and actively interacting with followers to foster an engaged online community. A Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é uma joint venture entre a Wilson Sons e a Ultramar. title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

Overview

Se você gosta da área comercial, gosta de vender com propósito, busca impacto real na vida das pessoas e tem interesse real por educação financeira, a Brez Solutions convida você a fazer parte da nossa equipe de Consultores Comerciais.

Quem somos nós?

A Brez Solutions é uma consultoria financeira de destaque, reconhecida por oferecer serviços bancários completos através de uma plataforma sofisticada de produtos financeiros e oportunidades de investimento. Nosso modelo exclusivo, desenvolvido pela nossa CEO, que possui uma trajetória de sucesso atendendo milhares de clientes e interagindo com personalidades influentes e grandes empresas do mercado, proporciona uma consultoria financeira abrangente e personalizada.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o primeiro contato com leads da internet e redes sociais (WhatsApp, e-mail, formulários).
  • Qualificar o perfil e entender as dores, metas e objetivos do potencial cliente.
  • Agendar e conduzir reuniões online para apresentação da consultoria ou dos produtos.
  • Vender serviços de consultoria financeira com foco em organização, planejamento, investimentos e comportamento financeiro.

O que oferecemos

  • Salário fixo competitivo.
  • Bonificação por resultado de desempenho e comercialização de produtos e serviços.
  • Premiações por performance e metas batidas.
  • Treinamento contínuo com a CEO e especialistas.

  • Ambiente humano, colaborativo e com propósito.

Requisitos

  • Experiência anterior com vendas consultivas ou serviços financeiros (seguros, previdência, consórcio, investimentos).
  • Formação ou atuação em áreas como administração, economia, psicologia econômica, gestão financeira ou áreas correlatas.

6. Excelente capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.

7. Atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a qualidade das entregas.

Requisitos:

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.

Experiência em arquitetura de dados, engenharia de dados ou cargos semelhantes.
Experiência avançada em SQL e Python para manipulação e extração de dados.
Conhecimento avançado em estatística e modelagem preditiva.
Facilidade para entender desafios do negócio e transformar dados em insights acionáveis.

title: Volunteer System Manager
description:
Volunteer System Manager

Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). The Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model. This role leads the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform while overseeing essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT, and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset.
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification desired.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level | Employment type: Contract | Job function: Information Technology.

  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. title: Graphic Designer BRA (Remote)
description:
Job Overview

A Graphic Designer is responsible for creating compelling visual content that communicates a brand’s message effectively, captures attention, and engages its target audience. This role requires a blend of creative vision, design expertise, and technical proficiency to produce high-quality visuals across multiple platforms and formats.

Scope of Work

Graphic Designers work on a variety of projects, including digital and print media —such as social media graphics, website layouts, online advertisements, email templates, presentations, infographics, packaging, brochures, and event materials. They are skilled at translating complex ideas into clear, aesthetically pleasing designs that align with the company’s brand identity, tone, and visual guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include collaborating with marketing teams, copywriters, and other stakeholders to conceptualize and execute design projects, selecting appropriate color schemes, typography, imagery, and layouts that resonate with the intended audience. They must also adapt designs for different formats and devices , ensuring visual consistency and usability across various channels.

Required Technical Skills

Proficiency in industry-standard design software—such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, or Canva —is essential. A strong understanding of design principles, user experience (UX), and current design trends enables Graphic Designers to produce innovative and effective visuals.

Additional Responsibilities

Beyond design creation, Graphic Designers may be involved in maintaining brand asset libraries, preparing files for print or digital publication, and ensuring compliance with production specifications . They also review feedback, make revisions, and manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Required Qualifications

To excel in this role, a Graphic Designer needs exceptional attention to detail, creativity, time management, and communication skills , as well as the ability to balance artistic innovation with practical business objectives.

description:

Vaga exclusiva para mulheres, cis e trans. A Empodera incentiva fortemente a candidatura de mulheres negras, indígenas, LBT e com deficiência.

A Empodera está à procura de uma pessoa dinâmica, organizada e motivada para integrar nosso time e trabalhar para o empoderamento e garantia de direitos de meninas e mulheres.

A coordenadora de projetos pleno será responsável pela coordenação das atividades, cronograma, equipe e parcerias do projeto Futuros Seguros . As atividades da coordenadora serão desempenhadas objetivando alcançar as metas e resultados no planejamento, implementação da metodologia e na execução das atividades do projeto, garantindo qualidade e alinhamento com a missão e cultura da organização.

Futuros Seguros é um programa exclusivo para adolescentes grávidas e jovens mães, moradoras de comunidades socialmente vulnerabilizadas no Rio de Janeiro. Co-projetado com as participantes, o programa possui uma abordagem holística que, através do esporte, contribui para o seu desenvolvimento e empoderamento.

A Empodera –Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma organização, sem fins lucrativos, com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional. Fundada em 2017, desenvolve programas e projetos esportivos, com viés educacional, para meninas adolescentes e mulheres periféricas, e capacita organizações de todo o Brasil na criação de espaços seguros para meninas no esporte. A Empodera é uma organização especializada em gênero e esporte e trabalha em prol do empoderamento de meninas e mulheres, em sua pluralidade, utilizando as práticas corporais e esportivas como ferramentas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades socioemocionais e a discussão de temas-chave para que as atendidas desenvolvam seu pleno potencial e exerçam os seus direitos.

Principais responsabilidades

GESTÃO DE PROJETOS (40%)

  • Planejar e coordenar com autonomia a execução das atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento de metas, prazos e padrões de qualidade definidos pela organização;
  • Elaborar e executar estratégias de recrutamento de participantes e acompanhar a participação continuamente; e de mitigação de riscos;
  • Utilizar as ferramentas de comunicação e gestão de projetos da Empodera para o planejamento e atualização das ações do projeto;
  • Realizar relacionamento com parceiros locais e internacionais, assegurando cumprimento de prazos, entregas, relatórios e responsabilidades, e promovendo articulação e alinhamento estratégico;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua das metodologias, oficinas, ferramentas de trabalho e estratégias de mitigação de riscos, propondo ajustes e soluções operacionais;
  • Realizar treinamentos sobre a metodologia do projeto e sobre espaços seguros e inclusivos para meninas e mulheres no esporte, onde serão abordados os temas: gravidez na adolescência, liderança, direitos, enfrentamento à violênciacontra meninas e mulheres, enfrentamento ao racismo e outras formas de opressão;
  • Apoiar estratégias de comunicação e divulgação dos resultados do projeto, garantindo visibilidade e sistematização dos aprendizados;
  • Participar em eventos e reuniões de articulação comunitária, em redes, workshops, conferências e congressos relacionados à temática dos projetos da Empodera.

GESTÃO DE PESSOAS E LIDERANÇA DA EQUIPE (35%)

  • Orientar e acompanhar a equipe do projeto, oferecendo suporte técnico, assegurando coerência metodológica e acompanhamento do plano de trabalho;
  • Liderar processos de feedbacks individuais, planos de desenvolvimento profissional e de compensação;
  • Apoiar processos relacionados à equipe, como recrutamento, desligamento, acompanhamento de ponto, de acordo com as políticas institucionais.

MONITORAMENTO, AVALIAÇÃO E PRODUÇÃO DE CONHECIMENTO (15%)

  • Elaborar, revisar e sistematizar relatórios, materiais didáticos e produtos de conhecimento, incluindo diagnósticos, artigos e guias de atividades, atuando com autonomia na consolidação das informações;
  • Desenvolver/adaptar o plano e ferramentas de monitoramento e avaliação (M&A), acompanhar indicadores, analisar dados e propor ajustes para aprimorar a execução e alcançar resultados;
  • Coordenar e acompanhar a equipe no processo de inserção de dados na plataforma digital de coleta de dados dos projetos (checagem e inserção de fichas de inscrição, apoio e acompanhamento do lançamento de presenças).

GESTÃO ADMINISTRATIVA E ORÇAMENTÁRIA DO PROJETO E DEMAIS ATIVIDADES (10%)

  • Apoiar e organizar processos administrativos do projeto, incluindo documentação, planejamento de atividades, logística de oficinas e treinamentos, interface com áreas internas e prestação de contas;
  • Manter estreita articulação com os demais departamentos da Empodera (RH, DP, Administrativo e Financeiro), seguindo os fluxos e processos estabelecidos;
  • Acompanhar a execução orçamentária, garantindo conformidade com o planejamento e normas internas, e reportando ajustes necessários à gestão e coordenação financeira;
  • Participar de reuniões internas, grupos de trabalho, comitês temáticos e representações externas, fortalecendo a articulação institucional e a troca de conhecimentos;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de setores e processos institucionais, fortalecendo a estrutura organizacional e a implementação de boas práticas, com autonomia na execução das tarefas delegadas.

FORMAÇÃO, EXPERIÊNCIA E HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS

Formação: Nível superior completo em Educação Física, Ciência Sociais, Ciências Políticas, Relações Internacionais ou áreas afins, e conhecimento em educação, esporte e juventude. Pós-graduação e/ou especialização em gestão de projetos e áreas relacionadas, ou nas temáticas de Gênero, Sexualidade, Diversidade e Relações Étnico Raciais, será um diferencial.

Conhecimentos e experiência

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em coordenação de projetos;
  • Formação e/ou experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos sociais e/ou esportivos com adolescentes e jovens;
  • Experiência com coordenação de equipes;
  • Conhecimentos e experiências com as temáticas de Gênero, Diversidade, Sexualidade e Relações Étnicos Raciais;

  • Organização, planejamento e comprometimento com prazos e tarefas;

title: Maintenance Engineering Specialist-Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation
description:
Overview

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

We are seeking a Maintenance Engineering Specialist to join Maintenance Solution Department (MSD) under Global Manufacturing Excellence.

MSD is responsible for providing specialized and timely maintenance engineering support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities.

The primary role is to provide technical expertise pertaining to the development, launching, and assessment of various maintenance programs, processes, procedures and best practices for Global Manufacturing facilities.

Responsibilities

  • Develop maintenance processes, maintenance management strategy, work and performance management strategy and conduct Maintenance health assessment in line with GME and corporate requirements. This includes PM and PdM strategies, Organization structures, manpower analysis, cost analysis, etc., and appraise and prepare reports on the effectiveness of such processes.
  • Conduct data driven analyses to benchmark maintenance organization’s performance to identify gaps and set sustainable plan to close the gaps. This includes, but not limited to: Spending Analysis, Maintenance Effectiveness, operating costs of existing assets, PM, and PdM, Wrench time analysis, SAP Taxonomy, Planning & Scheduling, Personnel Competency, Budgeting Strategy, Bad Actors, and RAM Modeling.
  • Analyze facilities’ maintenance performance to establish reference baseline & issue frequent maintenance benchmarking reports to promote knowledge.
  • Review maintenance reporting mechanism and KPIs along with their trends to drive performance and provide recommendations accordingly.
  • Analyze maintenance spending in terms of manpower, equipment, materials procurement and outsource strategies.
  • Assist the line maintenance organizations in the implementation of approved programs such as TPRM or GM reliability model.
  • Develop methods and programs for handling new situations in maintenance fields. This will include prototype pumps, motors, compressors, turbines, valves, instrument systems and computer systems.
  • Design, in conjunction with engineering personnel and vendor representatives, alternative parts or systems.
  • Represent AMSD on standing Committees, Special Task Groups or Ad Hoc Committees.
  • Recommend work which can be economically assigned to contractor organizations and develops scope of work.
  • You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering from a recognized and approved program. A Mechanical Engineering Degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas downstream Sector.
  • You will be able to demonstrate high degree of technical competence in the area of maintenance programs and practices.
  • You will have experience with risk-based processes such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance & Risk Based Maintenance
  • You will have experience with TotalProductive Maintenance
  • You must have strong hands-on experience with Spare Parts and Materials procurement strategies
  • You will have Best-in-class Maintenance Planning, Scheduling and Work Prioritization experience
  • You must have strong Experience with Maintenance budgeting and spending control methodologies.
  • You will have Experience in field maintenance methodologies, processes, and procedures.
  • You will be able to demonstrate experience with CMMS such as SAP

title: Technology Contract Manager
description:
Technology Contract Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Technology Operations, the Technology Contract Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team, and work in close collaboration with the Technology teams based in Brazil and other key individuals responsible for overseeing the relationship, performance, and contract management of our strategic technology partners and suppliers. Drawing on your experience as part of significant sporting event, you will contribute to the success of this global spectacle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overseeing a diverse portfolio of technology contracts, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and performance standards.
  • Developing and implementing a robust contract management strategy to streamline processes and enhance overall efficiency.
  • Support the management of relationships across a large base of technology vendors and suppliers to foster collaboration and address any issues promptly.
  • Leading negotiations for contract renewals, amendments, and extensions to ensure favourable terms and cost-effectiveness.
  • Develop and create contracts, NDAs, and SoWs using established templates.
  • Proactively foster and nurture robust relationships within an ecosystem of partners and vendors, leveraging your experience from to benefit tournament in achieving its goals.
  • Manage the governance and controls framework, in collaboration with project leads / SMEs.
  • Proactively manage risks and issues within technology and change related to contract and performance management.
  • Apply expertise in reporting financial spend (using tools such as Power BI, SAP, etc.) related to contracts, invoices etc.
  • Lead and oversee tender processes, including initiating and executing technology purchase requisitions via SAP in accordance with procurement guidelines.
  • Coordinate multi-supplier/partner collaborations and contribute to decisions on supplier proposals to continually enhance services, including the development of an evaluation process.
  • Document management of all tender documents, contracts, and invoices in accordance with the storage management requirements.
  • Responsible for ensuring the execution of contracts follow the appropriate workflows via DocuSign.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or equivalent high education.

Qualification

  • Proven track record in managing and implementing Governance Processes.
  • Extensive experience in running KPI/SLA driven engagement.
  • Significant commercial and contract management experience.
  • Proven track record in leading procurements.
  • Strong understanding of suppliers and contract management.
  • Industry knowledge and experience or understanding of the structure and organization of utilities and their core activities.
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation.
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall technology contract management experience and minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex and high spend technology contracts across tier one telecoms and network providers

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent teamwork and leadership skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Conflict resolution skills are a must.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to manage teams remotely.
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High sense of accountability, trustworthiness, and ethics.
  • Customer and results oriented.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar a limpeza e desinfecção dos ambientes internos de uma aeronave (galley, cabine, poltronas e toaletes) seguindo as normas, tempos e procedimentos contidos no MGO, no PLD (Plano de Limpeza e Desinfecção), publicados e regidos segundo as normas da ANVISA (Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária), recolher o lixo de bordo e realizar o descarte conforme indicações;

Realizar a reposição dos materiais de conforto e higiene, tais como revistas, materiais de toalete e sacos de lixo para serem utilizados pelos passageiros e pela tripulação durante o voo;

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

title: Analista de Operações Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na orientação técnica da equipe, explanando sobre os padrões de qualidade preestabelecidos, acompanhando as tarefas executadas pelos profissionais em período de treinamento e efetuando a correção das ações realizadas de maneira inadequada, atuando como referência da área na ausência do superior imediato;
  • Analisar um problema novo e propor soluções através de pesquisa técnica e aprendizados com ocorrências anteriores, bem como antecipando problemas, simulando cenários e prevendo os impactos da solução de um problema em todo o processo que atua, a fim de propor alternativas para prevenção de crises;
  • Resolver problemas complexos, criar, inovar e modernizar processos;
  • Orientar tecnicamente os seus pares; Analisar o processo da realização do tratamento e controle de qualidade de água e de afluentes, monitorando os processos de tratamento de água e esgoto em todas as suas etapas (captação, tratamento, distribuição e coleta), para identificar melhorias para utilização de recursos, operação, manutenção e controle dos sistemas;
  • Apoiar na realização de estudos, diagnóstico e revisão do fluxo de atividades;
  • Executar atividades relacionadas com a operação, conservação e manutenção de sistemas de produção, controle de qualidade, abastecimento de água, coleta e disposição final de esgotos, realizando atividades internas;
  • Executar atividades relativas de analise da instalação, manutenção, remanejamento e prolongamento de redes de água e esgotos; Levantar e propor medidas aos impactos inerentes à implantação e operação das estações elevatórias, estações de tratamento de água e esgoto;
  • Fazer estudos e pesquisas para fins de diagnósticos e fiscalização de projetos e processos; Executar analise das leituras de níveis de reservatórios; Dirigir veículo para realização das atividades do cargo;
  • Avaliar controles e métodos para realizar melhorias na tomada de decisões;

title: Sales Analyst
description:
Sales Analyst

Department: Partnerships & Media

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

title: Field Medical Advisor - Brazil
description:
Our client is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on developing novel targeted therapies to inhibit frontier targets in RAS-addicted cancers. The company’s R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) Inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins, and RAS Companion Inhibitors for use in combination treatment strategies. As a new member of the team, you will join other outstanding professionals in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.

The Opportunity:

Syneos Health is seeking two Field Medical Advisors (FMAs) to support clinical trial programs in oncology across Latin America. This recruitment requires one FMA to be a resident of Brazil and one FMA to be a resident of Argentina.

This role will be instrumental in driving the scientific excellence, clinical insight, and medical strategy supporting our oncology pipeline and marketed products. The Medical Advisor ensures scientific integrity and alignment with global and LATAM medical affairs objectives. The position will require close collaboration with cross-functional partners including clinical development, regulatory, commercial, HEOR, market access, and field medical teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement the Medical Affairs strategy and tactical plans for assigned products and therapeutic areas, tailored to the local LATAM market (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Establish and maintain trusted scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and healthcare professionals across LATAM countries (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Provide medical oversight and scientific input to cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with regulatory and compliance standards.
  • Contribute to medical input in promotional and non-promotional materials, internal training, and advisory boards.
  • Plan and execute national medical meetings, symposia, and congress participation to enhance scientific visibility.
  • Support investigator-initiated trials and local clinical research activities in collaboration with global and regional teams.
  • Monitor the competitive and scientific landscape to inform internal strategy and provide actionable medical insights.
  • Partner with HEOR and market access to develop real-world evidence and outcomes research projects.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (local regulations in LATAM).
  • Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations and CROs, including site selection, Site Initiation Visits, and investigator engagement.
  • Provide scientific review to ensure medical accuracy in materials developed by cross functional teams, including non promotional content and internal scientific training.

Requirements:

  • Advanced scientific or medical degree (MD, PharmD, or PhD) required; oncology experience strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in Medical Affairs or related functions in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
  • Strong understanding of oncology clinical development, evidence generation, and treatment landscape.
  • Proven ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical data effectively.
  • Experience engaging with healthcare professionals, academic researchers, and medical societies.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and presentation skills.
  • Fluency in Spanish/Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
  • Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional, and multicultural environment.
  • Willingness to travel nationally and internationally (up to 70%).

Preferred Education, Experience and Skills:

  • Prior experience supporting oncology product launches or lifecycle management activities.
  • Strong network within the corresponding country oncology community (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Experience leading or supporting investigator-initiated or real-world evidence studies.
  • Knowledge of the corresponding country healthcare system, reimbursement structures, and compliance requirements (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Track record in publication planning, congress presentations, and scientific communications.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza novas ideias. Onde resultados são reconhecidos, os desafios são grandes e o aprendizado é ainda maior. Acreditamos em pessoas inquietas, que pensam como donas, que buscam sempre o melhor e têm coragem para inovar em um sector em plena evolução.

Na Light, cada talento que chega carrega o potencial de iluminar o futuro. Venha fazer parte dessa história.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

description:
Descrição da vaga

A área de Dados e Inteligência Artificial (Dados e IA) da Vibra Energia é responsável por construir, operar e evoluir as capacidades corporativas de dados e inteligência, garantindo que dados sejam confiáveis, acessíveis, governados e convertidos em decisões e automações de alto impacto para o negócio. A atuação é end-to-end, cobrindo:

  • Ingestão e integração de dados a partir de sistemas internos e fontes externas;
  • Armazenamento e processamento em nuvem, com camadas de data lake/warehouse e serving analítico;

  • BigQuery (camada central analítica);
  • Cloud Storage (data lake);
  • Pipelines/orquestração: Cloud Composer (Airflow), Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Workflows;
  • Transformação/modelagem: Dataform, padrões ELT/ETL ;
  • Governança/metadata: Dataplex, Data Catalog;
  • BI/consumo: Tableau, Power BI ou Looker;
  • IA/ML: Vertex AI (training, endpoints, pipelines), práticas de MLOps/monitoramento;
  • Observabilidade e segurança: Cloud Logging/Monitoring, auditoria, LGPD e eficiência de custos (FinOps);
  • Desenvolver soluções de ciência de dados e machine learning para resolver problemas de negócio, atuando do entendimento do problema à entrega de modelos/insights, utilizando Python, BigQuery e Vertex AI (quando aplicável), colaborando com engenharia para operacionalização e com áreas de negócio para capturar valor, incluindo casos que habilitam IA e agentes de IA.

  • Implementar pipelines de treino/inferência (ex.: notebooks + pipelines em Vertex AI, quando aplicável);
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em BigQuery e otimizar extrações para modelagem;
  • Apoiar deploy inicial e handoff para produção com engenharia/MLOps (endpoints, batch scoring, jobs agendados);
  • Documentar experimentos (métricas, versão de dados/modelo, decisões) e apoiar monitoramento (drift/performance, quando aplicável);

Requisitos

  • Python intermediário/avançado (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn; notebooks);
  • Estatística aplicada e fundamentos de ML (validação, overfitting, métricas);

  • Feature engineering e preparação robusta de dados;

Além da aprovação da certificadora (ABS Quality Evaluations), nosso SGQ foi auditado por cinco de nossos Clientes e aprovado para execução de projetos de engenharia críticos, incluindo a realização de atividades offshore com risco de parada de produção.

Por que se inscrever no nosso Banco de Talentos?

  • Diversidade de Projetos: Trabalhe em projetos desafiadores e de alto impacto, desde a implementação até a manutenção de plantas industriais em setores variados.

  • Certificação de Excelência: Faça parte de uma empresa certificada pela ISO 9001:2015, reconhecida por seu Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade robusto e por realizar projetos críticos, incluindo atividades offshore.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com uma equipe de profissionais apaixonados e experientes, comprometidos com a excelência e o sucesso coletivo.

Quem buscamos?

Se você é estudante de engenharia, tem interesse em projetos complexos e deseja crescer em uma empresa que valoriza qualidade e inovação, queremos conhecê-lo! Procuramos jovens talentos com disposição para aprender, habilidades técnicas em desenvolvimento e vontade de enfrentar novos desafios.

Venha fazer parte da SANDECH e ajude a moldar o futuro da engenharia. Estamos ansiosos para ver o que você pode trazer para nossa equipe!
