title: Manager, Business Development
description:
Job Description

The Business Development Manager drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Account Management and Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is the core sales position within the company responsible for new business and clients as well as managing and leveraging existing accounts. The Business Development Manager drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts.

What You Will Do

  • Implement strategy for Offshore and non-class services in region (GVC).
  • Prepare professional proposals and contracts for prospects and clients.
  • Support trade shows, conferences, seminars, exhibitions (booth setup, visitor engagement, demos, promotion).
  • Perform weekly CRM updates: new opportunities, status updates, proposal/contract uploads, trip reports.
  • Initiate/coordinate market research and prepare market intelligence presentations.
  • Perform other duties, maintain expertise via training/seminars.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).
  • Sell ABS services using the strength of local affiliates’ business structure.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited university or equivalent business/quality-related experience.
  • 5 or more years of experience in the industry is preferred.
  • Business experience in the manufacturing and/or technical service industry.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Self-motivated professional with a track record of sales leadership.
  • High energy professional with a commitment to succeed in sales and business development.
  • Facile with computers, both in preparing presentations and communications and in working within ABS QE’s operating platforms.
  • Familiarity with management systems is helpful. Otherwise, the ability to learn new areas quickly will be critical.
  • Sensitive to multicultural environments.
  • Excellent communicator both with customers and the sales team.
  • Focus on the result; strong desire to achieve objectives despite challenges.
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.

Reporting Relationships

Reports directly to the Director of Business Development or senior level manager.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Se você tem um perfil detalhista, é apaixonado por entender pessoas, orientar decisões com dados e transformar a experiência do cliente, e quer trabalhar em uma empresa GPTW, o PASA tem uma super oportunidade para você!

Vaga com aplicação para Rio de Janeiro ou Belo Horizonte

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Mapear e compreender a jornada do cliente (do onboarding ao pós-venda), construindo Mapa da Jornada do Cliente e Mapa de serviço (Blueprint) para identificar fricções, pontos de abandono e oportunidades de melhoria por área
  • Planejar, executar e analisar pesquisas de satisfação e esforço (ex.: NPS, CSAT, CES). Consolidar insights e apresentar relatórios executivos com recomendações priorizadas por impacto e esforço.
  • Monitorar indicadores de sucesso do cliente (ex.: churn, expansão, engajamento, tempo de resolução, FCR, tempo de resposta, adoção de features, health score) em Power BI, construindo dashboards e narrativas visuais para tomada de decisão.
  • Realizar análise de processos ponta a ponta (descoberta, desenho e melhoria contínua) aplicando PDCA, Lean, Kaizen e DMAIC (Lean Six Sigma); conduzir workshops de ideação com Design Thinking e priorização via Matriz Impacto x Esforço.
  • Conduzir diagnósticos de canais de atendimento (chat, e‑mail, telefone, app, web), avaliando tempo de resposta, qualidade, taxa de solução, sentimento e voz do cliente (VoC)
  • Estruturar e manter o backlog de melhorias de CX/CS, fazendo a interface com TI, Produto e Áreas de Negócio; aplicar Scrum/Kanban para planejamento de sprints, definição de épicos, histórias e critérios de aceite.
  • Apoiar e facilitar comitês de experiência e sucesso com toda a gerência: preparar materiais executivos (PowerPoint/Power BI), storytelling dos achados, plano de ação e seguimento das iniciativas; registrar decisões e responsáveis.
  • Desenvolver e validar hipóteses por meio de testes A/B, provas de conceito e pilotos; mensurar resultados, documentar aprendizados e escalar soluções.
  • Interface com a área de curadoria de conteúdos e fluxos de atendimento (base de conhecimento, FAQs, chatbots/URA), alinhando tom de voz e diretrizes de comunicação; promover autossuficiência e redução de esforço do cliente.
  • Atuar como guardião da visão centrada no cliente, influenciando stakeholders, promovendo rituais de CX/CS (Daily/Review/Retrospectiva) e acompanhando a execução até a entrega dos resultados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação

  • Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia de Produção, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação/MBAs em CX, CS, Gestão de Projetos ou Analytics são diferenciais.

Experiência

  • Experiência comprovada em Sucesso do Cliente e/ou Experiência do Cliente: condução de pesquisas (NPS/CSAT/CES), mapeamento de jornadas, análise de processos e apresentação executiva a comitês de gestão.
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e melhoria contínua (PDCA, Lean, Kaizen, DMAIC).
  • Experiência na integração de dados de múltiplos canais (atendimento, produto, marketing) e construção de dashboards em Power BI

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em setor de saúde ou serviços de grande base de clientes.
  • Conhecimento em automação de fluxos (ex.: Power Automate) e gestão de base de conhecimento.

  • A educação dos pequenos também é importe e por isso oferecemos Auxílio Creche ;

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the “Control Room” and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s “Visualizations” and that the “Data Pipelines” are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert' : When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Brazil – Remote: Data Engineer – Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from “Bronze” (Raw) to “Silver” (Cleaned) and “Gold” (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

Must Haves

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks.
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Reporting to the Solution Consulting Director and based in Brazil, the candidate will be responsible for all technical aspects of the sales cycle related to geomodelling solutions, while ensuring the highest standard of customer satisfaction. The candidate will play a key role in the development and execution of pre‑sales activities for geomodelling workflows, with deep expertise in SKUA, RMS and subsurface characterization.

Your Impact

  • Provide advanced technical support and consulting in Aspen SKUA and Aspen RMS geomodelling software.
  • Prepare, present and propose workflows for structural modeling, property modeling, seismic interpretation integration, reservoir characterization and uncertainty analysis.
  • Search, uncover, understand and analyze client/prospect needs and requirements to grow or penetrate accounts.
  • Conduct technical presentations and demonstrations on the AspenTech SSE subsurface applications suite, emphasizing SKUA and RMS.
  • Present integrated workflows combining geomodelling software with other tools in the AspenTech suite (e.g., seismic interpretation, petrophysics, flow simulation).
  • Conduct pilot projects showcasing geomodelling workflows, demonstrating differentiators of SKUA/RMS versus equivalent market solutions.
  • Co‑develop sales proposals together with the sales team.
  • Run advanced demonstrations and presentations at customer sites, workshops and trade shows.
  • Identify, evaluate and recommend proof‑of‑concept and evaluation opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with users through personal contact, onsite engagements and user group meetings.
  • Communicate with product managers and developers on issues identified from field observations and customer feedback.
  • Deliver high‑quality basic and advanced training on geomodelling workflows and modules within SKUA and RMS.
  • Provide troubleshooting and advanced user assistance; own issues until resolution or appropriate escalation. Demonstrate proficiency with internal support procedures and tracking systems.
  • Continue to develop technical expertise in geomodelling methodologies, reservoir characterization and integrated subsurface workflows. Seek opportunities for personal development of non‑technical competencies.
  • Complete and submit Consultant Activity Reports after each project in a timely manner.
  • Provide feedback to R&D and Product Management to contribute to continued improvement of our geoscience solutions.

What You’ll Need

  • Advanced knowledge of geomodeling, reservoir characterization, structural modeling, property modeling and uncertainty workflows.
  • Experience working with complex geological settings such as carbonates, unconventionals, tight sands, salt tectonics and structurally complex reservoirs.
  • Expertise in handling subsurface datasets: seismic interpretations, well logs, geological maps, core data and reservoir simulation grids.
  • Capable of conducting high‑quality basic and advanced classroom training on SKUA and RMS modules and workflows.
  • Background in multidisciplinary collaboration to improve integrated interpretation and modeling results.
  • Experience with data management, quality control and subsurface data integration workflows.

description:
Descrição da vaga

A DMS Logistics é uma multinacional brasileira de agenciamento de carga, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no comércio exterior e especializada em freight forwarder. Aqui você trabalhará no setor Technology que é o responsável pelo desenvolvimento, implementação e acompanhamento dos sistemas internos da DMS, além de garantir sua melhoria contínua e atualizações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais desafios:

  • Desenvolver o roadmap estratégico de Segurança da Informação da DMS, planejando a evolução da área, adoção de novas ferramentas e ampliação da equipe;
  • Atuar hands‑on nas frentes de defesa (Blue Team) e ataque (Red Team), sendo a referência técnica principal em segurança da informação.

Blue Team (Defesa):

  • Monitorar ambientes em nuvem (AWS) e sistemas internos em busca de atividades maliciosas;
  • Gerir o plano de resposta a incidentes, conduzindo investigações e mitigação de eventos de segurança;
  • Implementar e administrar ferramentas de segurança, como SIEM, EDR e IDS/IPS;
  • Realizar gestão de vulnerabilidades, acompanhando a correção das falhas;
  • Garantir conformidade com boas práticas de segurança e regulamentações, incluindo LGPD.

Red Team (Ataque):

  • Executar testes de penetração e ethical hacking em aplicações, especialmente no Cockpit e portais de clientes;
  • Simular ataques, como phishing e engenharia social, para fortalecer a conscientização dos colaboradores;
  • Analisar arquiteturas de novos sistemas para identificar falhas de segurança ainda na fase de design;
  • Produzir relatórios detalhados sobre vulnerabilidades, com recomendações claras e planos de ação.

Requisitos e qualificações

Pré‑requisitos:

  • Residir em São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro;
  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado – será testado;
  • Experiência em Segurança da Informação, com atuação em Red e/ou Blue Team;
  • Conhecimento técnico em segurança de redes (incluindo firewalls), sistemas operacionais e aplicações web;
  • Experiência prática com segurança em ambientes de nuvem (AWS é um grande diferencial);
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de segurança, como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e OWASP Top 10;
  • Capacidade de automatizar tarefas de segurança com linguagens de script (Python, Shell etc.);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de EDR/XDR (Endpoint Detection and Response), como SentinelOne ou equivalentes – desejável;
  • Certificações de segurança ofensiva (ex.: OSCP, OSCE) e/ou defensiva (ex.: GCIH, GCFA, CISSP) – desejável;
  • Experiência na implementação de cultura DevSecOps – desejável;
  • Experiência com análise de malware e forense digital – desejável;

Informações adicionais

Na DMS respiramos inovação e somos fascinados por pessoas! Aqui temos plano de carreira e gestão do desempenho, com oportunidades reais de crescimento, além dos desafios e possibilidade de colocar em prática seus conhecimentos.

Aqui valorizamos o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, por isso investimos na sua capacitação, proporcionando um ambiente leve, diverso, ágil e colaborativo para você desempenhar as suas tarefas de forma híbrida, flexível e planejada. title: Lead Software Engineer - Web Platform
description:
Overview

The Role You will take full ownership of an existing production Next.js application. You will maintain it, evolve it, and make long-term technical decisions that directly affect the business. This is not a greenfield role. This is not a junior role. This is not a feature-only role. You own the system.

What You Will Do

  • Own the Next.js codebase in production
  • Ship reliable changes daily via full CI/CD
  • Maintain automated deploy pipelines
  • Own unit and end-to-end test coverage on critical paths
  • Handle production issues end-to-end
  • Make architectural decisions with long-term consequences
  • Improve maintainability without slowing delivery
  • Document systems and decisions clearly

What Success Looks Like

  • The CTO is no longer involved in day-to-day engineering
  • Production is boring and predictable, supported by CI/CD, automated deploys, and test coverage
  • The codebase becomes easier to work with over time
  • Features ship without drama or rework

Who This Is For

  • Engineers who have owned production systems
  • People comfortable being accountable for failures
  • Builders who prefer shipping over perfection
  • Developers who think in outcomes, not tools

Who This Is Not For

  • Early-career engineers
  • People who need constant direction
  • Engineers who avoid production responsibility
  • Resume-driven or framework-tourist developers

Required Experience

  • Ownership of a production web application
  • Experience maintaining inherited codebases
  • Deep familiarity with Next.js in production
  • Comfort debugging real-world issues

A pessoa que conquistar a vaga na área de Analista Júnior de BI aqui na inChurch irá desempenhar as seguintes atividades:

Missão

Ser o owner técnico da automação de fluxos financeiros (n8n) e da camada de dados para dashboards e KPIs, garantindo confiabilidade, rastreabilidade e escalabilidade.

Escopo (evolução)

  • Fase 1: automação ponta a ponta dos fluxos críticos + estabilização (observabilidade, retries, SLAs)
  • Fase 2: construção de camada analítica + Power BI (data model, medidas, governança de indicadores)

Responsabilidades

  • Desenhar, implementar e manter workflows n8n de missão crítica (integrações, filas, reprocessamento, idempotência, controle de versões).
  • Integrar fontes (APIs, bancos, planilhas, ferramentas internas) e garantir qualidade de dados (validações, reconciliação, trilha de auditoria).
  • Construir queries e pipelines em SQL para bases analíticas e controles (views, tabelas de apoio, agregações).
  • Usar Python quando fizer sentido (tratamento de dados, conectores, validações, automações fora do n8n).
  • Desenvolver dashboards em Power BI (modelagem, DAX, incremental/refresh, publicação, governança de KPIs).
  • Definir e manter KPIs operacionais do Financeiro (ex.: DSO, aging, inadimplência, cobrança, conciliação, acurácia do fechamento, performance de fluxos).
  • Implementar monitoramento: alertas, logs, métricas, painéis de saúde dos fluxos (SLA, falhas, gargalos).

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia em BI/Analytics/Automação (mesmo que curta, mas prática).
  • n8n, Power BI, Python, Excel e SQL (todos essenciais).
  • Boa base de dados: modelagem, integridade, reconciliação, performance básica de queries.
  • Mão na massa para atuar com demandas do Financeiro (CR/CP/Fechamento/Cobrança/Recebíveis).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com PostgreSQL / BigQuery (ou similares), Git, Docker/Deploy.
  • Conhecimento de rotinas financeiras e controles (fechamento, conciliação, NFs, recebíveis, régua de cobrança).
  • Observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, alertas, Sentry/Grafana/etc.).

Competências comportamentais

  • Ownership (pega o problema, fecha a ponta, documenta e deixa escalável).
  • Priorização por impacto (tempo economizado, risco reduzido, confiabilidade).
  • Comunicação de status com clareza (bloqueios, riscos, plano de mitigação).

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a 'deliver fast' mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Fully remote position.

About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

Why You’re Here

You’ll be the engine behind getting Zyte’s story and brand out into the world. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing Zyte.com content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top-of-mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.

You’re here to:

  • Amplify and reinforce the Zyte brand as an authority in web scraping.
  • Drive maximum reach and engagement for Zyte content.
  • Reach our ICPs where they are, at scale.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Content Amplification: Turn Zyte content into intelligent cross-channel campaigns and ensure it reaches the right audiences.
  • AI-Powered Execution: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) to repurpose content at scale.

  • Campaign Velocity: Launch fast, iterative campaigns with tailored messaging per channel—no bloated briefs.

Quantitative

  • New audience growth (traffic, reach, social engagement)

Qualitative

  • Innovation in AI-driven content repurposing
  • Speed and creativity of campaign execution
  • Ability to crack web data professional ecosystems with authentic content
  • Cross-team collaboration and impact on broader demand gen goals

Who You Are

  • Technical ICP-Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat.
  • Channel Fluent: You know how to break into niche ecosystems with the right tone, content, and delivery.
  • AI-Native: You use AI as a natural part of your workflow, not an afterthought. We need to see this in your mentality.
  • Campaign Writing Aficionado: You know what it takes to take a great piece of content and ensure our target audiences see it and appreciate it. This includes the ability to repurpose, identify alternative formats (video, infographics, podcast episode, etc.), and amplify the core messages.
  • Fast-Moving: You value execution speed and iteration over perfect briefs.

  • Strong copywriting + AI-assisted content skills
  • Track record of fast, iterative campaign launches across channels, with a strong working knowledge of channel nuances.

Tech You’ll work with

  • Figma, Notion, Google Workspace
  • ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs for message generation and ideation

How We Work

We move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.

As a new Zytan, you will:

Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.

Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.

Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.

Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

Ideal role for an experienced & ambitious scientist within agronomy. As our Senior Research and Development (R&D) Manager you will lead and be responsible for managing our research and development programme relating to deployment of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a carbon dioxide removal technique in Brazil, with a special focus on agronomic trials. You will design, manage and interpret data from experiments in order to effectively monitor agronomic parameters and as well as helping to address fundamental research questions relating to ERW. You will be based in Brazil, with presence onsite at various locations within Brazil when necessary.

The Impact you can make

This role will oversee and manage team members, and you will take ownership over experiments, driving forward our scientific strategy. You lead our reporting on farmer co-benefits and impact metrics, providing robust scientific evidence to support the case for our wider impact. You will play a key role in managing and driving our science strategy and will be expected to maintain and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Core working relationships

Reporting to the VP of Science and Research, you will support and work effectively with all members of the science and operations teams. You will lead and work closely with our Science and Impact Lead and our Agronomic R&D Lead.

Key Responsibilities

  • Management of team members within our agronomy R+D programme
  • Overseeing and planning our agronomy R+D programme, such as the design of experiments and communication with external stakeholders
  • Generating, analysing, presenting, and publishing data from experiments and deployments to wide-ranging and high-profile audiences
  • You will support operations to provide the robust scientific evidence for our farmer pitches and case studies
  • You drive research and the wider science team strategy
  • You manage communications and partnerships with leading researchers globally, with a specific focus on Brazil
  • You will work with flexibility in Brazil, with travel to onsite experiments within Brazil and to visit partners (expectation & benefit)

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

  • You have extensive experience in research and development and experimental design, with a focus on agronomy or a related field

Join to apply for the Senior Manager - Flights Marketing (Bangkok-based, relocation provided) role at Agoda.

About Agoda – At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005 when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. We connect people to destinations and experiences with our deals across millions of hotels, holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

We are data‑driven and technology‑centric, fueling curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to start your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Performance Marketing Team at Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. It is highly data‑driven and focuses on developing large‑scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable initiatives and channels. The team blends top analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists. Leadership has deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields, fostering a learning environment where you can grow by working closely with experts worldwide.

In This Role, You’ll Get to:

  • Define the marketing strategy for the Flights vertical (outside of pricing).
  • Spearhead the development, execution, and optimization strategy for growing Agoda’s Flights business on different channels (CRM, paid performance marketing).
  • Conduct end‑to‑end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights.
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.g., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data‑driven decisions for channel growth.
  • Partner closely with various business functions, especially Marketing Accommodation, Flights Product, and Flights Supply, to identify opportunities and interpret trends using SQL, Tableau, and other tools.
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of business initiatives, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of analysts and managers; participate in hiring and onboarding of new team members.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • 8+ years in a data analyst role or similar, preferably in tech, e‑commerce, or digital marketing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, economics, or finance.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and generate impactful recommendations.
  • Proficiency in business intelligence tools and data warehouse technologies (SQL, Tableau, MS Excel).
  • Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills, with experience creating visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management experience, including influencing senior management with strong commercial acumen.
  • People‑management experience – hiring, coaching, and developing team members.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, get‑things‑done attitude.

It’s Great If You Have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing.
  • Experience in the online travel or e‑commerce industry.
  • Experience with hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python or R for data manipulation and analysis.

Job Details

  • Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level

Job Duties

Design the future of decision‑making in energy.

Landmark, Halliburton’s technology division, is modernizing a global enterprise platform used by geoscientists and engineers to make high‑impact operational decisions. We are expanding our UX team and hiring for two dedicated roles:

  • UX Researcher
  • Senior UX Designer

These are distinct positions with focused scope, though hybrid profiles with strengths in both areas are welcome.

This is not incremental UI work. It is large‑scale UX modernization across complex, legacy and cloud‑based applications. You will help elevate product clarity, usability, and trust in deeply technical workflows used around the world.

You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and customers to embed user‑centered thinking into roadmap decisions and product execution.

What You’ll Do

If You Are a Senior UX Designer

You will lead the design of complex workflows and deliver end‑to‑end solutions that raise the craft quality of Landmark applications.

  • Own UX design for major workflows or product areas
  • Translate business and technical requirements into intuitive, scalable design solutions
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished visual designs
  • Apply and extend the Landmark design system; contribute new patterns when needed
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to align requirements and deliverables
  • Validate designs with users and iterate based on feedback
  • Participate in and elevate design reviews across the organization

If You Are a UX Researcher

You will embed insight into product strategy and modernization efforts, ensuring decisions are grounded in real user needs.

  • Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative research across complex enterprise workflows
  • Lead usability testing, interviews, contextual inquiry, and journey mapping
  • Identify unmet user needs and opportunity areas within legacy and cloud applications
  • Synthesize findings into actionable insights for product and engineering teams
  • Influence roadmap decisions through evidence‑based recommendations
  • Establish scalable research practices within product teams
  • Partner with designers to validate concepts and measure experience improvements

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Senior UX Designer

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating enterprise or technical product design
  • Mastery of interaction and visual design
  • Proficiency with Figma and modern prototyping tools
  • Experience working in Agile environments
  • Familiarity with Angular or React‑based systems preferred

UX Researcher

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Factors, HCI, Psychology, or related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Experience conducting research in enterprise or technical domains
  • Strong qualitative research skills; quantitative experience a plus
  • Ability to translate research into product and business impact
  • Experience collaborating with cross‑functional product teams

For Both Roles

  • Experience navigating complex technical environments
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
  • Comfort working in legacy systems undergoing modernization
  • A desire to shape and elevate UX within a global enterprise organization

title: Senior Manager, Service Delivery FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Service Delivery Manager is responsible for all aspects of Service Delivery Management for Corporate and Tournament technology support operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails working in close collaboration with the Technology teams in Brazil and Zurich, and other key stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and implement a fit for purpose integrated support model (including FIFA, technology partners, service providers, government entities etc.) across all phases of the project.
  • Management / implementation of IT Service management processes and procedures including the management of the ITSM tool.
  • Establish service level agreements (SLAs) in accordance with the FIFA Technology Handbook across all technology services.
  • Be the lead manager for Service Delivery area within the FWWC27 Technology Project team
  • Recruitment of direct reports in the next phase of hiring & contracting, who will in turn be responsible to deliver their key area of scope.
  • Lead on the definition of the Asset tracking and management of deployed equipment in all sites.
  • Ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed to scope, within budget and on schedule.
  • Continuously review and make recommendations to improve technology across the tournament.
  • Contribute to the Technology readiness program, including test events and exercises, policies and procedures and training of the team
  • Be a key member of the Technology team and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation and FIFA Technology team as defined by the operational organizational structure.
  • Lead, build and manage a strong diverse team composed of paid staff, contractors, and volunteers for operating the technology services in scope.

Your profile

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and project
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Service Delivery Management.
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical skills and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team Player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • ITIL foundations
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers.

The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones.

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). For the first time, it is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly oversee the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Key Responsibilities

System Expertise

  • Strong expertise in Oracle BRM, with special focus in the following areas
  • Product Design Center (PDC): configuration for realtime and offline events
  • Integration: Development of opcodes and expose them as REST APIs to manage complex simple and complex billing hierarchies
  • Invoicing: Invoice, Receipts and Credit Notes templates design (Oracle Analytics Publisher, OAP)
  • Billing Operations: bill cycle execution, financial reporting, troubleshooting
  • Participate in the design and implementation of complex business and technical requirements, ensuring robustness, scalability, and alignment with Oracle's best practices

Training & Enablement

  • Conduct workshops and hands‑on sessions with billing team

Operational Support

  • Collaborate with IT and Finance to streamline billing processes
  • Provide guidance on troubleshooting billing discrepancies and customer disputes
  • Recommend improvements to workflows, reporting, and data access (including use of replicated databases for secure read‑only queries)

Requirements

Must Have

  • Proven technical expertise in Oracle BRM for 3 or more years
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and database query optimization for large datasets
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to train and mentor non‑technical staff
  • Familiarity with billing operations, financial reporting, and compliance standards
  • Problem‑solving mindset with attention to detail and data accuracy

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience leading billing teams or training programs
  • Knowledge of cloud‑based Oracle BRM solutions
  • Understanding of telecom, subscription‑based billing models and partner / revenue share models

  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard
